currentVersion.title: Search Bar Pre-Selection Focus, Live TV Malformed Container Fix & VOD Decoder Auto-Recovery
currentVersion.releaseNotes:
• Instant Search Bar Focus: Search bar immediately highlights the moment TV remote D-pad moves over it before pressing Select, featuring 1.04x scale expansion, 3dp amber border, glowing halo shadow, and 'PRESS OK TO SEARCH' gold badge
• Live TV Container Fix: Resolved 'ERROR_CODE_PARSING_CONTAINER_MALFORMED' by removing strict AUD detection from MPEG-TS extractors, adding SCTE-35 splice stream tolerance, and rejecting deceptive HTML error pages in the media stream
• VOD Decoder Auto-Recovery & 4K Crash Protection: Fixed decoding failed reconnect stalls by auto-advancing past corrupt keyframes and refreshing hardware codec surfaces; reduced backBuffer to 20s to eliminate 4K out-of-memory crashes

releases.title: Search Bar Pre-Selection Focus, Live TV Malformed Container Fix & VOD Decoder Auto-Recovery
releases.releaseNotes:
• Instant Search Bar Focus: Search bar immediately highlights the moment TV remote D-pad moves over it before pressing Select, featuring 1.04x scale expansion, 3dp amber border, glowing halo shadow, and 'PRESS OK TO SEARCH' gold badge
• Live TV Container Fix: Resolved 'ERROR_CODE_PARSING_CONTAINER_MALFORMED' by removing strict AUD detection from MPEG-TS extractors, adding SCTE-35 splice stream tolerance, and rejecting deceptive HTML error pages in the media stream
• VOD Decoder Auto-Recovery & 4K Crash Protection: Fixed decoding failed reconnect stalls by auto-advancing past corrupt keyframes and refreshing hardware codec surfaces; reduced backBuffer to 20s to eliminate 4K out-of-memory crashes

releases.title: Restored Functional VOD Player Configuration & YouTube / Search Focus Enhancements
releases.releaseNotes:
• Restored VOD Configuration: Fully reverted VOD media engine to the proven functional configuration (prioritize time over size, extension renderers prefer, standard 30s buffer) to guarantee reliable movie & series streaming
• YouTube Feeds & Playback Resilience: Preserved fix eliminating global pauseTimers freeze and added instant channel RSS fallbacks so feeds never stall
• Search Bar Pre-Selection Focus: Preserved distinct TV remote focus highlight with 1.03x scale expansion, amber halo glow, and 'PRESS OK TO SEARCH' cue

releases.title: 4K VOD Crash Fix, YouTube Feeds & Playback Resilience, and Search Bar Pre-Selection Focus
releases.releaseNotes:
• 4K VOD Stability: Eliminated 4K movie crashes and sudden app closure by disabling excessive backBuffer retention, removing prioritizeTimeOverSizeThresholds, dynamically querying HDMI audio capabilities, and enabling largeHeap
• YouTube Feeds & Playback Resilience: Resolved subsequent playback freezes by eliminating global WebView pauseTimers, adding genre memory caching, and introducing guaranteed instant official RSS feed fallbacks
• Search Bar Pre-Selection Focus: Unmistakable visual cues when moving over the search bar via D-pad before selection: animated scale expansion (1.03x), glowing amber shadow, and high-contrast 'PRESS OK TO SEARCH' badge

releases.title: Restored Music & Podcasts Video Playback, Native YouTube Player & Stability Fixes
releases.releaseNotes:
• Restored Music & Podcasts Playback: Reverted to the rock-solid v2.1.5 player architecture with native WebView integration and privacy-enhanced youtube-nocookie embedding
• Fixed Video Playback Lockup: Removed artificial desktop Windows UA and hardware layer override that caused black screens and bot verification blocks on YouTube
• Reliable Media Transitions: Full media engine reinitialization during System Reboot with clean socket pool tear-down
• Animated Search Focus: Distinct 3dp border glow and SEARCH label pill on remote D-pad focus

releases.title: Media Engine Reinitialization, YouTube Feeds Fix & Animated Search Focus
releases.releaseNotes:
• Media Engine Reinitialization: System Reboot completely resets media OkHttp dispatcher and socket pool with full ExoPlayer rebuild
• YouTube, Music & Podcasts Recovery: Prevented premature cancellation of in-flight catalog and feed requests during reboot
• High-Contrast Search Focus: Smooth animated color and 3dp border expansion on D-pad focus with visible SEARCH label pill

releases.title: Music Video Playback Fix, TV Dinner System Reboot, Module-Wide History & Rated-R Filtering
releases.releaseNotes:
• Music & Podcasts Playback: Eliminated black screens and hesitation on music videos with modern desktop Chrome UA and instant playback watchdog
• TV Dinner System Reboot: Added streaming system reset button in Settings to flush playback engines, socket pools, and caches without touching credentials
• Module-Wide History: Added 🕒 History to Movies, Series, Music, and Podcasts with selective multi-section clear dialog in Settings
• Rated R Adult Filter: Automatically hides 'Rated R' movie categories and titles when the Adult Content Filter is active
• Closed Captions: Updated Settings Closed Captions toggle and remote CC shortcuts to apply directly to Music and Podcasts

releases.title: VOD Playback Stabilization, Seamless Transitions, Start-at-Beginning & Podcasts Navigation
releases.releaseNotes:
• VOD Playback Stabilization: Fixed stream errors and socket drops across the app with dedicated OkHttp dispatcher and extended 25s buffering headroom
• Seamless Media Transitions: Switch between any media (Live TV, Movies, Series, Podcasts, Music) with clean state reset and zero need to restart app
• VOD Start-at-Beginning: Movies and Series strictly start from 0:00 unless 'Resume' is explicitly chosen in the dialog
• Podcasts Remote Back Navigation: Pressing Back on remote when viewing a channel's episode list returns directly to previous search or category view
• Dashboard Re-Publishing: Re-publish former or archived releases directly from the update dashboard with one click

releases.title: Favorites Ceiling Focus, Fast Updates, Seamless Navigation & Credential Gating
releases.releaseNotes:
• Favorites Ceiling Focus: Favorites is now the hard ceiling focus in categories; pressing Up stays in categories and never escapes to Search
• Channels-to-Search Navigation: Pressing D-Pad Up from top channel navigates directly to Search in TV/desktop mode
• Unblocked Channel Navigation: Guaranteed instant Right navigation from categories to channels under all conditions without unmounting list
• 10x Faster Downloads: Overhauled OTA update downloads with 128KB buffered I/O and throttled progress updates to download at full wire speed
• Media Transition Hardening: Isolated streaming sockets and added stream generation tokens to eliminate disruptions and stale recovery timers
• Verified Credential Gating: Music and Podcasts are strictly gated behind verified active credentials

releases.title: Live TV Category Navigation Fix & Priority VOD Poster Loading
releases.releaseNotes:
• Live TV D-Pad Navigation: Fixed controller lock when navigating Right from active playing category back into channels
• Instant Channel Focus: Restores channel list position and focuses active playing channel when returning to its category
• VOD Poster Loading: Resolved random timeouts and unloaded cards with dedicated 64-request OkHttp dispatcher and expanded connection pooling
• TMDB Optimization: Scaled poster resolution to w342 for 5x faster card rendering and enhanced media tag sanitization for higher match rates
• Poster Fallbacks: Automatic retry with exponential backoff and structured title/year fallback cards for missing posters

releases.title: Native Installer Restoration & Smooth Update Workflow
releases.releaseNotes:
• Native Installer Restoration: Completely removed custom permission interception that caused install hangs on Fire TV and Android TV
• Direct Package Launch: Direct handoff to Android's native package installer with standard URI permissions
• Clean Package com.tvdinner: Fully migrated clean package namespace with all v2.1.1 improvements

releases.title: Clean Package Migration, Live TV Rewind, English CC & Safe Search
releases.releaseNotes:
• Clean Package Migration: Migrated package identifier to com.tvdinner, removing all legacy developer tags
• Live TV Rewind: Use remote Left button to step back up to 2 minutes in live stream buffer
• Return to Live: Use remote Right button to advance toward live feed (right button becomes no-op once at live)
• English Closed Captions: Automatic prioritization of English subtitle/CC tracks whenever captions are enabled
• Adult Search Isolation: Adult items are strictly excluded from search results unless an adult category tab is selected

releases.title: Reliable OTA Installer, High-Contrast Search Focus & Remote Enhancements
releases.releaseNotes:
• OTA Update Reliability: Instant package installer launch with cached APK persistence (no re-download required) and unknown app permission handling
• Distinct Version Details: Accurate, version-specific release notes for each release in update dialogs
• High-Contrast Search Focus: Search bars across Live TV, Movies, Series, Music, and Podcasts glow bright cyan/blue when focused
• Music Fast Skipping: Ultra-responsive YouTube track transitions using loadVideoById with zero playback dropouts
• Podcasts Remote Navigation: Press D-Pad UP during podcast playback to immediately jump to the previous episode

releases.title: Live TV Navigation Fix, Backup Portal Failover & Priority Card Art Loading
releases.releaseNotes:
• Live TV: Seamless right navigation from categories into channels across all categories (not just Favorites & History)
• Backup Portal Failover: Plugged in http://vpn.uhd4.top:80 as official failover for bad HTTP status / stream drop recovery
• In-App Stream Reconnect: Added clean socket eviction and Reconnect Stream button so app restart is never needed
• Movies & Series Poster Priority: Proactive preloading of visible cards in viewing order with dedicated fast Coil timeouts
• Settings: Added Primary and Backup Portal URL configuration fields

• Category Reorder: Moved News Network, Sports Network, Movie Network, Kids Network, Prime, PPV & Events, 4K Relax under Entertainment
